subject.title: [Feature]:  Shared sessions across multiple group/channel/thread chats

question: What shared-session contract should OpenClaw support for selected group/channel/thread chats, and how should it expose the trust boundary?
rationale: Current main has no requested config surface, related proposals are partial, and merging live chat contexts is a product and security decision rather than a narrow implementation repair.

options.title: Design one explicit shared-session contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and reconcile channelGroups, groupScope, named inbound routing, and identity routing into one documented opt-in design.

options.title: Stage the narrower groupScope path first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91702 as a narrower group-to-main implementation candidate while keeping this broader issue open for selected channel/thread groups.

options.title: Defer core routing changes
options.body: Document memory/session tools as the supported workaround for now, accepting that they do not provide live transcript sharing.

recommendation.title: Design one explicit shared-session contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and reconcile channelGroups, groupScope, named inbound routing, and identity routing into one documented opt-in design.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent routing history and prior review context on this exact session-routing cluster.
